The size of the stamp is too big and will look good on women with large eyes or when you make your eyes appear larger with eyeshadow. HACKS :-- If the stamp doesn't work then take another sketch liner and rub its ink on the stamp and you will get your stamp. If you don't like the big wing - there is another way - using a sketch liner, apply ink on the EDGE of the stamp - use this to get a thin wing line. You can join it with the remaining eyeline to get one smooth line. Actually I found the liner tip to be much user-friendly to extend a nice thin wing. Also the product is really smudge-proof. It took some effort to remove it using oil and face wash. Even if you think this is a lousy buy, the stamp by itself is useful. Don't throw it away. Hope this helps.

review_text: I'll go Cons first then the Pros- Cons: 1. The cap and the bottom outer part of the lipstick are made of paper stock which is obviously not sturdy at all and runs the risk of getting ruined in case of contact with water. 2. With the inner plastic part/s the packaging is not completely biodegradable. So the paper stock outer shell has no purpose apart from lowering the manufacturing cost. 3. The retail price is 599, which is too high to get a paper stock outer shell and no ingredients mentioned anywhere (so we cannot even be sure that we're getting a high-quality lipstick). Pros: 1. The package is very eye-catching. 2. The creamy matte texture does not crack your lips(if you have droughty lips like mine, you might wanna prep your lips with a thick lip balm before). 3. Adding lip balm or lip gloss won't disrupt the consistency of its pigment. 4. Can be applied with light taps on the lips for a subtle nude finish and can be built up for color intensity. 5. Can be worn both for everyday office look or evening party looks.

review_title: Spot On Masaba Nykaa- Bergamot, Tea, Osmanthus, Oriental floral very classy and unique, yet budget friendly
review_text: The opening of this perfume smells spicy and little citrusy from the top notes of Bergamot and tea. I am not familiar with Osmanthus which is known to have a sweet honey-like aroma, so cannot comment on that. Though personally I loved the middle and base notes more, which is mildly sweet-powdery-feminine-vintage-floral by nature. The floral part is a bit similar to warm orange blossom and the powdery-ness is possibly coming from the musk which is nicely taming down the floral frangrance. But there is something more special about the perfume. It does keep a deep charming trail as it demands. The smell matures and develops very nicely on skin, mixes up with the natural body smell through the right amount of moist pungentness of Patchouli. So the skin smells really impressive and sensual after giving the perfume a time to settle down. The dry down phase is very pleasant and it stays for long hours. The staying power is pretty good specially in dry season, I could surprisingly smell it even after 24hours on my skin after the first application. Hence, I feel it is really good for spring and dry summer season. People who love powdery or musky perfumes or those who want to avoid mainstream floral aromas like rose, jasmine, tuberose, lavender etc, won't regret trying it at all.

review_text: I have these lipsticks in two shades: 1) Sandstorm (07) and Soft-Spoken (04). While reading the reviews I could understand most of the positive and negative comments. I have thin lips that tend to be dry, though not rough nor with lines. I also tend to prefer satin to matte finishes. I have tried them with and without lip primer - they last much longer with lip primer. (You have to let the primer completely set before applying the lip cream. I also apply a very light touch of mineral-based powder on my lips before applying the lip cream). The color also lasts much longer if you use a lipstick sealer because they will transfer easily. (Also allow the lip cream time to dry completely, which won't take long if you use one coat before applying the sealer). However, they do eventually set for me, though admittingly, it takes a while if you use more than one coat. They can become a bit too matte for most peoples' taste. The tacky texture is from multiple layers being applied. These wear best with only one, slow application. I love them because the colors are pretty good for the price, the pigment is decent, and the matte finish. Pros: Formula feels great, slides on lips easily, wand is perfect for shaping, and I love the size of the tube (big) and the larger sized wand (as well as more product), and it's decently pigmented for the price. Cons: Does require some patience to work with, can dry very matte.

review_text: I have tried the shade Baddest Beige from this line, which my sister got for me from the states, but now it's almost over. I was so happy to know that I can finally repurchase that shade that, Jaclyn Hill raves about constantly too, and also try the other ones... but when I saw the lack of nudes and the shade names. I was taken aback. None of the shade names matches with the ones that SO MANY YouTubers have made swatch videos for. Like, for example, We have here, the shade Mauve Mayhem while other countries, have it as Spicy Mauve. Seriously, NONE of the shades matches. Idk if these are counterfeit products or if they've made a separate shade range for Indian skin tones, and I'd really like to be reassured so I can actually buy a few. But just for the record, These are highly pigmented. They're like a hybrid of a lipgloss and lipstick but in a tube. They don't last very long but keep your lips moisturized because of the oils in it. They glide smoothly and have a really soft texture. They look even better once you layer: first with a lip liner, then the lipstick and lastly, top it off with a gloss.

review_text: This is something I use on a daily basis. This product is one of those things I can't do without! The product comes in a duo form with a brow pencil on one end and a powder on the other. I personally use the shade Brown. The pencil is sturdy and waxy(to a very comfortable level) and sufficiently pigmented. It comes in a twist packaging. You can draw fine lines and shape your brows easily without worrying about the pencil breaking. The formulation is pretty buildable so there's no problem of depositing excess product and going around with clown brows. The powder is used to fill in the brows after you've lined them with the pencil. But if you're in a hurry (which I am almost everyday) then the powder is all you need to have natural, shaped brows. The powder comes with a sponge which is very handy and doesn't create a mess. The powder alone tends to budge a little after 4-5hours but if used along with the pencil stays on for a pretty long time.. I really love this product because it's affordable and effective and it literally takes a lot of time to finish one tube(the powder mainly) even with regular use because you wouldn't need a huge lot of product. In short totally recommended specially for those who want an affordable,effective and easy-to-use brow product!

review_title: Smudge proof, waterproof, moisturizing ceramids by Lakme
review_text: Inspired by the creamy vivid colours of gelato ice cream, Lakmé Absolute introduces Kohl Ultimate - The Gelato Collection. Turn heads with this range of 8 deliciously-hued eye pencils that look like eye candy - for real! These fresh pops of colour-on-a-stick are sure to reinvent the way you do your everyday makeup. Each pencil has a creamy consistency enriched with moisturising ceramides that glides effortlessly on your skin. Stay carefree about your makeup during work hours or party time as it is smudge-proof as well as waterproof. Get a rich colour payoff with these pigmented, super long wear shades. You can use this multi-purpose eye pencil by wearing it on your eyelid as a liner or blend it a little to add a subtle pop of colour to your eyes. We recommend applying 2 coats of mascara for a striking look. Available in 8 ice cream inspired shades - Raspberry, Matcha, Mandarino, Black Currant, Lagoon, Limoncello, Spearmint and Candy Floss. Dial up the fun and let your eyes do the talking with these ‘eye-catching’ shades! How to Use: Clean the area around your eyes. Draw a line from the inner corner of your upper eyelid, Pull down your lower lid to line under the eye! Smudge with your finger or a brush if desired.

review_text: Colour: 05 Lagoon Price I bought for: ?499 I was quite sceptical about the longevity and colour pay-off for this eye pencil but the colour was just so gorgeous I had to try it out! And thank goodness I did, because I'm in love with this pencil. The colour is intense just as shown in the pictures and it glides smoothly and stays put for a longg time without bleeding. I have an oily waterline, so every single black eye pencil I've tried will inevitably bleed under my waterline by the end of the day, only difference would be how much it bled. But, not this one! This one just stays put! No bleeding under the eyes (or at least it's not visible because of the colour ;) ) I only hope this formula is available in black or even brown for that matter. Only thing is, I have to go over a couple times to get the intense colour as shown in the images, but I do that with every eye pencil I've ever tried. Nothing is really ever one-stroke-application really. Since this eye pencil does not bleed, it has sort of become my everyday kajal. Love the pop of colour it provides. Makes my eyes look brighter! review_text: This range is the lowest range from Lakme in terms of the price point. So, nothing extraordinary should be expected out of this collection. The silver plastic bullet packaging looks and feels really cheap. The color is a gorgeous purple shade. It has shimmer in it. Very good pigmentation and color payoff. It gives a buildable medium to full coverage. In one or two strokes it gives an opaque look to the lips. Smooth in application. Settles into a creamy, silky, satin finish. Its not smudge proof or waterproof. It might bleed also. Staying power is approximately 3-4 hours. Shelf life of this product is 3 years. Quantity and quality for this rate are pretty decent. I know a lot of people absolutely hate its smell, but I like it a lot. Overall if one is in budget and not really into makeup or are newbies to makeup, they can purchase this lip color.

review_title: All the above shades are perfect for Indian skin tones.
review_text: The foundation is quite flowy and liquidy and can actually drip if you hold the dropper upright without pressing the nozzle. I love the texture of this foundation and also the fact that it blends easily on your skin. Ivory Cream (01)- This shade is great for fair skin tones with yellow undertones. Rose Silk (02)- This shade is great for fair skin tones with pink undertones. Silk Golden (03)- This shade is similar to ivory cream but has a a bit more of the yellow undertones and will match fair-medium skin tones. Natural Light (04)- This shade is a dupe for NC 40 (I feel) which is a bit on fair side with yellow undertones. Honey Dew (05)- This particular shade will match most of the Indian medium skin tones. Both 04 and 05 suit me because of the prominent yellow undertones so I prefer mixing them both for a perfect shade match! 05 alone can look a bit dark (still wearable) and 04 has the perfect shade that keeps my complexion looking healthy, so mixing them both works for me. This shade will suit anyone who use NC 42 in MAC. Natural Almond (06)- This is a bit darker than 05 and has very prominent and visible yellow undertones. this shade should go well with medium-dark or dusky skin tones. Although, this can still look a bit yellowish or weird on very dark skin tones.

review_text: The product is light to medium buildable coverage. You can have a sheer coverage with just one layer or you can layer 2 more times to build it up wherever you need more coverage. Since it is a very runny formula, please build it up slowly so that you are not left with uneven streaks or lines on the face. It is good for normal to dry skin which provides a beautiful natural glow to the skin. It has SPF 45 that is enough to protect skin from the sun. I prefer using a dense brush to get maximum effect. Since it is a dewy foundation it does transfer if you do not set it with loose powder or compact. This foundation does not oxidize on my skin at all. This foundation will not work well for extremely oily skin. Even if you have combination skin this foundation is not a good choice in very hot summer days when you are out in the sun or sweating a lot. This product will give you a nice glow and leave your skin dewy and healthy looking. But if you sweat a lot or produce too much oil, the foundation will wear off your skin easily and make you look more sweaty. Dry to normal skin beauties can use it any time of the year they want.

You'll always feel that you've applied something on the lips . Not everyone would like that feeling. Also it doesn't come off easily , i tried the normal micellar water but didn't help . An oil based makeup remover or a balm will do a good job of removing this lipstick. Talking about the shade , it's a proper light pink shade , with blue undertones. It will suit only light to medium complexions. It's not a very good shade for dusky complexions as it will make your face washes out. 4 stars for the color payoff and staying power. Overall it's a good one for the price but I'd say there are better lipsticks available in that same range , in the same brand . I honestly wouldn't repurchase any other shade from this range.

review_title: Alcol denat. and Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone are icky ingredients
review_text: Alpha-Isomethyl Ionone is a common fragrance ingredient that is one of the “EU 26 fragrances” that has to be labelled separately (and cannot be simply included in the term “fragrance/perfume” on the label) because of allergen potential. Best to avoid if your skin is sensitive. If you want to start a debate between skincare experts, mentioning alcohol will probably be a good way to do that (Btw, denat means denaturated and it's normal alcohol with some additives that make it poisonous and bad tasting so that people do not drink it.). It's a controversial ingredient that has definitely many immediate skincare benefits and some potential longer-term drawbacks. So let's see first the benefits, why it's so often used. First, it is a great solvent. There are some ingredients that do not dissolve in water or oil and alcohol is often the way to go. Second, it's great at creating cosmetically elegant, fast absorbing, thin formulas. For example creating a nice, non-oily sunscreen is still a big challenge to the cosmetic industry (because sunscreen ingredients are yucky and oily) and alcohol can help with this problem. Third, alcohol is a great astringent, leaves a refreshing feeling on the skin so it's very popular as a toner ingredient. And last but not least, it's antimicrobial, helps to disinfect the skin so it is common in after-shaves or products intended for acne-prone skin. It even works as a preservative that is often used in natural products. So now let's see what's not so good about it: First, it dries the skin. As an immediate effect for oily skin types that might sound like a benefit, but in the longer term alcohol often dries out the skin so much that the skin compensates with extra oil production. Famous dermatologist, Dr. Leslie Baumann in her Skin Type Solution book suggests avoiding alcohol if it's in the first 7 positions on the ingredient list. Skin care expert, Paula Begoun thinks that alcohol not only dries the skin but regular exposure to it damages the skin barrier and causes inflammation. Not everyone agrees with this. Nicki Zevola from Futurederm thinks that alcohol evaporates quickly from the skin, can act as a penetration enhancer for key ingredients and is safe to use. So the bottom line is that alcohol (and to further complicate we are talking only about simple, volatile, low molecular weight alcohols here) is debated. What seems to be a fact is that it's drying but it also has several benefits. Based on that it's up to you to decide if it's something to avoid or not. SO HUGE NO TO THIS ONE.

review_text: A very decent powder at this price range. It sets my makeup very well. The fit me concealer just after application seems like it settled into the small lines under my eyes which i never knew i had btw looks very bad up close though not visible from afar but this powder sort of camouflages the effect so i can finish up that nasty concealer. Now i didn't expect this to be comparable to any high end powder but it's very good on it's own. I recommend everyone to try at least once and since it isn't too yellow like other brand banana powders you can use it for setting your blush, corners of eyeshadow or contours; it won't change the color. My makeup didn't budge for 6hrs when i applied this. But remember to use it in only required amount otherwise your base color will be affected. The powder wasn't dry for me just moisturize your skin really well and apply a hydrating or glowy sunscreen it'll look awesome and not emphasize the dry patches. The biggest con though IT DOESN'T HAVE ANY INGREDIENT LIST. It's true it didn't cause any reaction on me even though i used it for 6 times i think but an ingredient list is absolutely essential we have the right to know what we are applying to our face since we are paying for this product. I am still on the lookout for a talc-free powder with minimal ingredients for everyday use since i will be needing it for my college and a good very light coverage concealer. Hoping to find my hg soon🤞

review_text: It's a bright warm toned pink blush.There are no orange or brown hints in it. This would look fabulous on fair to medium skin and on medium to dusky skin it would look great with makeup on cause on my bare dusky skin it doesn't make much difference. It's not value for money since it's costly and also as I am dusky I need more quantity. Just 10 ml product won't last much if used regularly. On oily skin it blends seamlessly, can't comment for normal to dry skin. This shade is not meant for deeper skin tones. The brand should consider making rusty red or brown or berry toned blushes for deeper skin tones. I have a lipstick of similar colour and I can literally use even that as a blush. But since I never had any cream blush I bought this. Overall decent product but pricey. On oily skin it will last only for 1-2 hrs.
